items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He’s still alive today, and we’re still friends.

ctx.x: So you were well received there.

I was well received. I stayed a long time. A man named Bosse Broberg was the head of the jazz system of the time. He took care of all the jazz music. He just took his hat off. They recorded everything I ever did.
